fato_historico: 1920: Irish War of Independence: British police known as "Black and Tans" burn the town of Balbriggan and kill two local men in revenge for an IRA assassination.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a powerful drive to transform past tensions into vibrant new beginnings. Like a phoenix rising from the ashes of history, consider how your resilient spirit can mend what was broken. It is a good time to focus on healing, fostering harmony, and channeling your fiery energy into building something truly lasting and meaningful for your future path.
frase_do_dia: Every ending creates space for a beautiful and courageous new beginning to unfold.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of wisdom.
conselho: Focus your passion on constructive growth rather than dwelling on past conflicts.
